$comment: ADR-540: dedicated cougar + wolverine art. The atlases have NO image files of their own: their pixels are painted at runtime by apps/client/src/task540-art.ts (software rasterizer -> blob URL, the Task 34 / ADR-421 pattern) and the sources override in view.ts points the registry at those blob URLs, so the image/ktx2 paths below are never fetched. They point at a real pack atlas (items_build, the same dummy the Task 34 creatures use) only because the pack test requires every manifest atlas to name a PNG + KTX2 twin that exist on disk. Atlas layout is a plain grid (frame() math): 8 direction rows x 4 anims, idle rows 0-7, walk rows 8-15, attack rows 16-23, death rows 24-31, dirStride = columns = 8. run reuses the walk frames at 12 fps (the fauna.py convention); hit / swim / eat fall back through the renderer's STATE_ANIMS table (hit -> idle, swim -> walk, eat -> idle). Attack has no fallback, so it is painted. Cougar cells are 56px (448x1792 atlas), wolverine 48px (384x1536) — both under the 2048px mobile cap.
name: survivaz-task540
